remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)
add_definitions(-DUNICODE -D_WIN32 -DPORTMAP -D_CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE=1)

spec2def(libtirpc.dll libtirpc/libtirpc.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# libtirpc.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/libtirpc-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The translated C, kept on disk:
#    src/auth_des.c
#    src/auth_gss.c
#    src/authgss_prot.c
#    src/crypt_client.c
#    src/des_crypt.c
#    src/svc_auth_des.c
#    src/svc_auth_gss.c
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(libtirpc_shims OBJECT src/asprintf.c src/authdes_prot.c src/auth_none.c src/auth_sspi.c src/authsspi_prot.c src/auth_time.c src/auth_unix.c src/authunix_prot.c src/bindresvport.c src/clnt_bcast.c src/clnt_dg.c src/clnt_generic.c src/clnt_perror.c src/clnt_raw.c src/clnt_simple.c src/clnt_vc.c src/des_soft.c src/epoll_sub.c src/getnetconfig.c src/getnetpath.c src/getpeereid.c src/getpublickey.c src/getrpcent.c src/getrpcport.c src/gettimeofday.c src/key_call.c src/key_prot_xdr.c src/mt_misc.c src/netname.c src/netnamer.c src/pmap_clnt.c src/pmap_getmaps.c src/pmap_getport.c src/pmap_prot2.c src/pmap_prot.c src/pmap_rmt.c src/rpcb_clnt.c src/rpcb_prot.c src/rpcb_st_xdr.c src/rpc_callmsg.c src/rpc_commondata.c src/rpcdname.c src/rpc_dtablesize.c src/rpc_generic.c src/rpc_prot.c src/rpc_soc.c src/rtime.c src/svc_auth.c src/svc_auth_none.c src/svc_auth_unix.c src/svc.c src/svc_dg.c src/svc_generic.c src/svc_raw.c src/svc_run.c src/svc_simple.c src/svc_vc.c src/winstubs.c src/wintirpc.c src/xdr_array.c src/xdr.c src/xdr_float.c src/xdr_mem.c src/xdr_rec.c src/xdr_reference.c src/xdr_sizeof.c src/xdr_stdio.c)
target_link_libraries(libtirpc_shims PRIVATE oldnames libuser32 libadvapi32 libkernel32_vista libws2_32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_include_directories(libtirpc_shims PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tirpc)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(libtirpc_shims PRIVATE /wd4273 /wd4313)
endif()
if(MSVC)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
        target_compile_options(libtirpc_shims PRIVATE /wd4101 /wd4133 /wd4473 /wd4477)
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT (MSVC))
    target_compile_options(libtirpc_shims PRIVATE "-w")
endif()
add_cargo_module(libtirpc libtirpc-cargo libtirpc.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS libtirpc_shims psdk)
